reviews.title: Wish I Could Adjust Calories for Daily Exercise
reviews.text: I really enjoy this app, and switched over from a different tracking app because this one is more user friendly and looks better. However, I’m thinking about switching back because the old app had a feature where you could adjust daily calorie goal based on calories burned for exercise- for example, in the old app I would enter in that I burned 200 calories by running 2 miles, and then I would eat an extra 200 calories to stay healthy. Now with this app I still eat the extra food, but now when I look back on my month I can’t tell how well I have been hitting my calorie deficit goal. Please add a feature like this MacrosFirst!

reviews.title: Great but two major annoyances
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a couple months now and overall am very pleased. The number of features they provide on the free version is impressive! And I rarely have to manually enter a food (even for restaurants) because the number of items they already have is so vast. But I can’t for the life of me figure out why I need to essentially confirm adding food to the journal TWICE. You click into the meal, search or scan your food, insert the amount and save. But that simply adds it to a queue that you have to save again! I have had to redo so many entries because if you don’t save it the second time and you leave the app for too long it wipes out everything you’ve entered. Even if I remember all the details it’s super frustrating to have to enter it again. But it’s even worse when I have no recollection of the serving size and there’s no way for me to retrieve that. I use a scale a lot, so if I haven’t taken down the weight somewhere else, that information is just gone. I wish it would save it to my day the first time. Then if I get pulled away and can’t finish entering everything from my meal in one session, it’s there for me to pick up and finish later. I have ADHD and a toddler so I rarely finish entering everything from my meal in one session. Saving too aggressively is much easier to recover from than saving too conservatively. I’d much rather have to delete things that were saved too soon than lose information I can’t get back because it’s saved too late. Also my husband and I share meals and recipes back-and-forth quite frequently. When I open a recipe he shared with me and select log it to my day a date picker and list of meals shows up. If I select the meal but then change the date, it resets the meal and I have to enter it again! The meal selection should not be affected by the date picker. This one is more of a nuisance than a functional issue, but it’s still aggravating. If those two things were fixed this would be a five star review.
